ops.body:
- **T? [arch] A backup larger than one zip can hold (65,535 files or 4 GiB)** (2026-11-21)
  Area: backup. Seen: the auditor's probe in the back-up-everything diff review (Nov 21): 70,000 `ZipPassThrough` entries written by fflate read back as 4,464, with no error; fflate 0.8.2 neither writes nor reads ZIP64 (`node_modules/fflate/lib/index.cjs` l.942, l.1887-1893). Today such a library is refused in words before the file is handed over ("This backup would be too large for one file, so it was not made.", back-up-everything audit 12, 13), so a person with a library of years cannot back up. Rests on: decision 0241 ("every walk, moment and file", one zip); the restore slice reads the same file.
  Recommended: a ZIP64 writer and reader of our own over fflate's streams (the records past 65,535 entries and 4 GiB), held by a test that writes and reads back a file past both; no new dependency; the restore slice needs the reader too. /vision: no surface (the file and the words stay as they are).
  Precedent: none checked (the auditor read fflate's source, not adjacent apps).
  Otherwise: split a large backup into parts, each a plain zip with its own manifest naming the set (the page saying the file comes in parts); or leave the refusal.

- **T? [owner] Chronicle's Contents is a mixed menu behind a label that says table of contents** (2026-11-21)
  Area: memories. Seen: `cf-1.png`, `cf-2.png` (the cold find of the back-up-everything slice, a fresh ux-reviewer told only "make a backup of everything", Nov 21): it chose "Contents" only by elimination ("reads as a table of contents"), then found Your data at once; the sheet mixes views (Threads, Reactions, Hidden), a setting drawn as a row ("Bring moments back / On"), a destructive action styled as the others ("Forget my choices") and Your data right after it (C1-C3). Rests on: specs/chronicle-journal JN21 ("A contents button at the top of the page labelled Contents, opens a list"), its ui 6 ("the word Contents in ink"; "the switch drawn as a menu row is deferred"); decision 0177 (Contents, Reactions stays).
  Recommended: group the sheet: the views (Threads, Reactions, Hidden), the settings ("Bring moments back" as a switch), your data (Your data), and "Forget my choices" set apart as destructive; and give the header control a label or spoken name that covers what is inside. /vision: aligned (Return: what Chronicle holds is found again; Always, "Restraint in motion, colour and copy": grouping only, no count, colour or new control kind).
  Precedent: not checked (the cold find read no research); not yet recorded in `docs/research/adjacent-apps.md`.
  Otherwise: a divider before Your data only; or leave it.

- [loop] On Memories, a moment's text is drawn through under the sticky date header ("Saturday, October 3") as the page scrolls (`cf-1.png`, the back-up-everything cold find, Nov 21; its C4, low, off the task's path, older than that slice): give the header a solid ground and room below it.

**Nov 21, `/tend inbox G10 yes --deploy=main`, one build** (opened from `38af22b1`, rebased onto `8d4eebd4` at the diff pause and onto `cadcde61` before publishing; lens 0 and the build only; lenses 1-6 belong to a sweep and were not run).
- G10, "Your data: back up everything into one versioned zip", the owner's yes in person 2026-11-20, built as `specs/back-up-everything` (BK1-BK14, decisions 0241, 0249): the last row of Walk settings and an entry in Chronicle's Contents open "Your data"; Back up everything makes one plain, versioned zip of every walk, trace, moment and file, every kept row and the person's choices, a download on the web and the share sheet on a phone; "Last backup made", no reminder, no size or count; a reader core that reads every format version, a frozen sample; a delete waiting for Undo left out; past what one zip holds, refused in words. Native never run on a phone. G10 left Next evolutions.
- The steward's plan review: 10 accepted before code (back-up-everything audit 1-10), the owner's answers in person 2026-11-20 (decision 0249). The diff review (auditor, ux-reviewer with the cold find, steward; one round): 12 fixed (audit 11-22), 8 lows `[loop]` in "Back up everything" and "Map, walk screen and motion polish", 1 rejected; the owner's answers in person 2026-11-21 ("Add a door in Chronicle"; the date alone; no version number). The cold find after the door: found, with hesitation at launch (Contents chosen by elimination).
- Lens 0: backup had no line; E-backup-1 to 4 drafted (proposed, the steward's corrections), each met by its check in this run (the `backup` journey, `npm test`).
- Filed: T52 `[arch]` (a backup past one zip: a ZIP64 writer and reader of our own), T53 `[owner]` (Chronicle's Contents, a mixed menu behind its label); `[loop]` in "Chronicle journal, cut 1" (text under Memories' sticky date header).
- Decision numbers moved twice under the run: written as 0247, main took it (poi-any-distance), then 0248 (town identity); it is 0249.
